Sora AI is OpenAI's text-to-video model that generates clips up to 60 seconds in 1080p (and up to 4K on higher tiers), supporting widescreen 16:9, portrait 9:16, and square 1:1 aspect ratios. It maintains character and scene consistency across multiple shots and accepts text or image prompts via ChatGPT Plus/Pro or the API. For creators, it's best for prototyping, short-form social content, and storyboarding, though outputs may need cleanup for production use.

Sora AI, OpenAI's text-to-video model, enables marketers to generate product demos and ad visuals from text prompts, filmmakers to create pre-visualizations and storyboards, and social media creators to produce short-form content without expensive equipment or crews.
